title: 36 Hours in Los Angeles
abstract: Home to captivating art, deeply rooted ethnic communities and world-class food, the nation’s second largest city is vivid, soulful and eclectic.

title: 36 Hours in Chicago
abstract: The neighborhoods on Chicago’s near northwest side are an invigorating blend of reflection and reinvention.

title: 36 Hours in Valencia, Spain
abstract: Artistic and culinary innovation continue to transform every corner of this perpetually sunny city.

title: 36 Hours in Cleveland
abstract: Whatever the fallout from the forthcoming Republican National Convention, Cleveland, with its booming food scene and revitalized downtown, is camera ready.
